consultedSources.title: Structural functions of diminutives and their productivity in modern Russian
consultedSources.locator: Abstract; journal citation metadata: Voprosy Jazykoznanija, 2020(5), 38–56. Abstract says diminutives express smallness and/or affection and reports corpus study of five derivational patterns; does not establish all lexeme-specific readings in these entries.
consultedSources.use: General morphological support only; no evidence here for every lexicalized sense or constructed example.

consultedSources.title: Diminutives in Russian at the early stages of acquisition
consultedSources.locator: Chapter 2, pp. 44–46: pp. 44–45 discuss smallness/endearment and nonliteral size; p. 45, Table 1 lists productive suffixes including -ik/-ok and examples домик/столик; pp. 46–47 give hypocoristics Са(ша) from Александр and Ма(ша) from Мария, and explain endearment/depreciative nuance.
consultedSources.use: Supports general diminutive productivity and the cited examples домик, столик, Саша, Маша. Not enough to prove the full contextual/pragmatic meanings of every item.
